primitives.name: Alias Target Resolution Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: Five aliases pointed at Nous IDs Nous does not host (nvidia :free slugs).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A': 'Set of model aliases', 'T_{host}': 'Set of hosted model IDs', 'R_{alias}': 'Resolution map from A to T_{host}'}

primitives.breakdown_regime: When target is unhosted, alias is retargeted to OpenRouter.

layer2.mapping: Derives alias-to-host mapping from catalog consistency checks and fallback redirection logic.
layer2.telemetry: Number of resolved vs. unresolved aliases.
